# Ish's Blog

> Welcome to Ish's blog. Find interesting articles and snippets about testing, software engineering and many more.

Ish Abbi writes about software testing, QA leadership, test automation, accessibility and the occasional personal journal entry. Links below point to clean Markdown copies of each page (drop the trailing `index.md` for the HTML version). The full text of every page is also available in one file at https://ishabbi.tech/llms-full.txt.

## Posts

- [Scoring your accessibility observations](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/a11y-score-cards/index.md): Learn ways of how one can quantify the results of your accessibility tests into a score (April 20, 2025)
- [QA Metrics: Leading and Lagging Indicators Every Tester Should Know](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/qa-best-practices-underdogs/index.md): You're a QA leader? Planning on being one? You've been asked for your north-star metric? (August 26, 2024)
- [Fetch GraphQL query from an Apollo client using APQ - Part 2](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/debug-apq-extension-part2/index.md): Struggling to automate GraphQL APIs or fetch queries? Learn about APQ and how to intercept these requests in this guide to GraphQL automation. (August 10, 2024)
- [Fetch GraphQL query from an Apollo client using APQ - Part 1](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/debug-apq-extension-part1/index.md): Struggling to automate GraphQL APIs or fetch queries? Learn about APQ and how to intercept these requests in this guide to GraphQL automation. (July 20, 2024)
- [Understanding the Selenium Webdriver](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/understanding-selenium-webdriver/index.md): Discover how Selenium works behind the scenes. While many test automation pros use it, few grasp its inner workings. Gain insider knowledge here. (February 19, 2020)
- [Generating HTML reports for your tests via Gradle](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/gradle-reporting-easy-way/index.md): Learn to create custom reports in Gradle using MarkupBuilder. This guide offers a starting method for crafting personalized project reports. (February 17, 2020)

## Journal

- [The problem with my username and the thought I had behind it](https://ishabbi.tech/posts/the-problem-with-my-username/index.md): For years I've been using a username because I felt it would keep me humble (June 12, 2026)
